ESSF.description: Element Stiffness Scale Factor (ESSF). A single ITEMS array of scale-factor entries keyed per element; each entry carries the seven section stiffness scale factors, an optional boundary group name, and a Part selector for composite sections.

ITEMS.description: Array of element stiffness scale-factor entries to assign.

ID.description: Serial number of the scale-factor entry.

ASY_SF.description: Scale factor for Asy (effective shear area resisting shear along the element local y-axis).

ASZ_SF.description: Scale factor for Asz (effective shear area resisting shear along the element local z-axis).

IXX_SF.description: Scale factor for Ixx (torsional resistance about the element local x-axis).

IYY_SF.description: Scale factor for Iyy (area moment of inertia about the element local y-axis).

IZZ_SF.description: Scale factor for Izz (area moment of inertia about the element local z-axis).

WGT_SF.description: Scale factor for Weight (cross-sectional area used for self-weight computation).

GROUP_NAME.description: Name of an existing Boundary Group to associate with this entry; must reference an existing group name when non-empty, otherwise the request is rejected. Empty string means no group.

iPart.description: Part selector for composite-type sections: 'Before' (before composite action), 'After' (after composite action), or 'All'. Case-insensitive.
